Command.Name: StoreEJByDateTime
Command.FPOperation: Store Electronic Journal Report from report from datetime to datetime to External SD card.

Arg.Name: OptionReportStorage

Option.Name: Storage in External SD card memory
Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Desc: 2 symbols for destination: - 'J4' - Storage in External SD card memory - 'JX' - Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Name: OptionReportFormat
Arg.Desc: 1 character with value - 'T' - Detailed EJ - 't' - Brief EJ

Arg.Name: StartRepFromDate
Arg.Desc: 16 symbols for initial date in the DD-MM-YYYY

Arg.Name: EndRepFromDate
Arg.Desc: 16 symbols for final date in the DD-MM-YYYY
